sisi.depan: In the far distance, a colossal, frozen cascade of solidified grey matter hangs suspended over a horizon of jagged, tooth-like peaks.
sisi.kanan: To the right, a dense cluster of sharp, obsidian-like shards juts out from the ashen ground, some reaching the height of a tall tree.
sisi.belakang: Behind the viewpoint, a series of low, windswept dunes of fine grey ash recede into a uniform haze.
sisi.kiri: On the left, a long, deep fissure cuts through the field, releasing slow plumes of pale grey smoke from its depths.

tengah: Scattered across the foreground are several brittle, coral-like formations of fused ash, their skeletal branches reaching towards the sky.
atas: A seamless, oppressive ceiling of motionless, slate-grey clouds blankets the entire sky, diffusing a flat, shadowless light.
